अश्रि(श्री) f. 1. The sharp side of anything; 2. an angle of a room or house; 3. the edge of a weapon, वृत्रस्य हन्तुः कुलिशं कुण्ठिताश्रीव लक्ष्यते K.S.ii.20. (This word is changed into अश्र when it follows चतुर्, त्रि, षट् and some other words in a compound, e.g. चतुरश्रशोभि K.S.i.32, where is explained by Mall. to mean (fig.) ‘free from defects,’ ‘symmetrical.’)

आश्रम m.n. 1. A hut, a hermitage, a dwelling of ascetics, रामगिर्याश्रमस्थः Megh.ii.38, i.1, R.i.48, 53, 58; 2. a period in the religious life of a Brāhmaṇa, of which there are four, viz., ब्रह्मचर्य, गार्हस्थ्य, वानप्रस्थ and संन्यास (the first three Āśramas are enjoined to Kṣatriyas and Vaiśyas also; according to some, they can even enter the fourth), स किलाश्रममन्त्यमाश्रितः R.viii.15; 3. a college, a school; 4. a wood or thicket where anchorites practise penance.
आश्रम-गुरु m. the head of a religious order, a preceptor.
आश्रम-धर्म m. 1. the special duties of each order or period of life; 2. the duties of one living an anchorite’s life, य इमामाश्रमधर्मे नियुंक्ते Sak.i.
आश्रम-पद, -मण्डल, -स्थान n. a hermitage with the surrounding grounds, a penance-grove, शान्तमिदमाश्रमपदं स्फुरति च बाहुः Sak.i.
आश्रम-पद, -मण्डल, -स्थान n. a hermitage with the surrounding grounds, a penance-grove, शान्तमिदमाश्रमपदं स्फुरति च बाहुः Sak.i.

आश्रम-भ्रष्ट a. fallen from any religious order.
आश्रमिक a. (f. की) Belonging to any of the four orders.

आश्रय m. 1. Substratum, receptacle, resting place, i.e. द्रव्याश्रयेष्वपि गुणेषु रराज नीलः or तमाश्रयं दुष्प्रसहस्य तेजसः R.iii.58; 2. an asylum, a place of refuge, तदहमाश्रयोन्मूलनेनैव त्वामकामां करोमि Mud.ii.; 3. prop, support, R.ix.60; 4. a quiver, बाणमाश्रयमुखात् R.xi.26; 5. assistance, help; 6. authority, sanction; 7. dependence; 8. patron, supporter, master, विनाश्रयं न तिष्ठन्ति पण्डिता वनिता लताः Ud.; 9. connection, association; 10. seeking protection (one of the six modes of foreign policy.) See आसन 5.
आश्रय-आश, -भुज् m. fire, किं नाम खलसंसर्गः कुरुते नाश्रयाशवत् Ud.

आश्रय-लिंग a. a word the gender of which must agree with the gender of the word to which it is referred.
आश्रयण n. 1. Refuge, asylum; 2. taking refuge with.
